scope: EXT-F-1009-T08 native screenshot gallery failure recovery
source_evidence: Runner requires the supplied local dev receipt and verifies manifest version, unpacked tree hash, and build identity before and after the owned-profile run.

It observes one exact gallery GET failure for the owned fixture URL, requires the gallery error to remain visible, then requires a trusted Refresh to produce a new real HTTP 200 empty response and recovered empty UI.

The runner does not serialize the fixture URL, organization name or ID, credentials, response content, or intercepted request URL into its report; it records bounded booleans and fixed failure categories.

attempt.cleanup: No native child or owned profile was started; the resource guard rejected the command during validation before acquiring the heavy lease.

limitation: Native UI behavior remains unverified because this runner command is absent from the resource policy allowlist.
